test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A dishonest shopkeeper claims that he sells rock salt at ₹17/kg, which costs him 20/kg. But he gives 567 g instead of 1134 g. What is his profit percentage?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Profit/Loss is calculated using the **Successive Ratio** method.

Price Ratio (CP : SP) = 20 : 17

Weight Ratio (Inverse of quantity) = 567 : 1134 = 1 : 2

Combined Ratio = (20 × 1) : (17 × 2) = 20 : 34 = 10 : 17

Profit% = (17 − 10) ÷ 10 × 100 = 7 ÷ 10 × 100 = 70%.

**∴ The correct answer is Profit of 70%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **Cost Price (CP)** = ₹20/kg, **Selling Price (SP)** = ₹17/kg, **Actual weight given** = 567 g, **Claimed weight** = 1134 g.
Formulas: Profit% = (Net SP − Net CP) ÷ Net CP × 100 | Total SP = (Price × Claimed Weight) | Total CP = (Cost × Actual Weight).
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0692a6517443feb7038c989e05da9d97397c3a3a4e8b5395aa5f6a0101c023a2.png] 
⇒ Effective Cost for shopkeeper = CP × (Actual Weight ÷ 1000) = 20 × (567 ÷ 1000) = ₹11.34.
⇒ Effective Revenue for shopkeeper = SP × (Claimed Weight ÷ 1000) = 17 × (1134 ÷ 1000) = ₹19.278.
⇒ Profit = 19.278 − 11.34 = ₹7.938.
⇒ Profit% = (7.938 ÷ 11.34) × 100.
⇒ Profit% = 0.7 × 100 = 70%.

**∴ The correct answer is Profit of 70%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Concept

A dealer can earn profit by either **marking up the price** or by using **faulty weights**. If a dealer sells at CP but uses less weight, Gain% = [Error ÷ (True Value − Error)] × 100.

Combined Multiplier

When multiple factors (price change and weight change) occur, the **Net Profit Factor** is the product of the individual ratios: (SP/CP)Pᵣᵢ꜀ₑ × (True Weight/Actual Weight).
